authority_note: Initial structured migration of the six active v0.187 conditions. No new conditions are invented in this pass. Numeric pool modifiers in legacy prose are represented as typed disadvantage effects, not generic bonus/penalty dice.

conditions.name: Prone

effects.scope: distant ranged attacks against or involving the prone position

conditions.notes: Voluntarily dropping Prone remains governed by the action rules.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.notes: Exact opposed resolution remains governed by the Grapple action authority.

conditions.name: Suppressed
conditions.notes: d6 is a named Disadvantage die from the condition; it is not a generic penalty die.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.notes: Physiological/shock-based Stunned may interact with explicit VAM removal effects.

conditions.name: Disoriented
conditions.notes: d4 is a named Disadvantage die from the condition; it is not a generic penalty die.

conditions.name: Restrained

effects.scope: physical actions materially hindered by the restraint

conditions.notes: The exact escape mechanism depends on the source of restraint.
